name: katana
label: katana
description: ProjectDiscovery katana: crawls one URL's host two levels deep (links and JavaScript; GET only, no other host, no redirects, no images/fonts/media) and reports each URL under the page it was found on.
contacts: fetches pages, scripts and other files linked from {target}, on that URL's host only (GET, two levels deep, at most 5 requests a second; redirects are not followed)
